Through Dr. Amany Veterinary Clinic in Damanhour, she provides veterinary examinations, preventive vaccinations, medical treatment, ongoing follow-up, and guidance on pet nutrition and care. The clinic also offers online booking and delivery services to make veterinary care more convenient for pet owners.
